description: Dispositions for procedure steps that restate an uncited rule (scripts/graph/duplicates.ts, phase_6.criterion_2). Every finding needs exactly one entry; an entry whose finding is gone fails the test. disposition: legitimate_repeat (kept, with the reason delegating to the rule would change behaviour). Convert any other finding to rule_refs.

entries.reason: combat.action.power_attack.enemy also sets to_hit_applies=false, whose timing is open (issue.combat.power_timing) and which the procedure takes as the supplied input enemy_to_hit_suppressed in procedure.combat_preparation, and it reads enemy_power_attack/enemy_size, which no earlier step establishes (the procedure has only large_attacker and cannot tell large from x_large). Delegating would change behaviour (PDF 115).

combat.defence.weapon_parry fires only in Parry Stance and compares the roll with plain CS (PDF 118); the step is also reached by a Fast weapon parry outside Parry Stance and compares with defence_threshold, which includes talent modifiers (PDF 177), and avoid also covers dodge. Delegating would drop negates_damage/defence_succeeded in those cases.
